# autonomous-ai-agency

An autonomous AI agency platform that orchestrates specialized AI agents to perform complex workflows, including research, portfolio management, agile development, and more.

## Key Pages

- **Main Site**: https://autonomous-ai-agency.com
- **Documentation**: https://docs.autonomous-ai-agency.com
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/autonomous-ai-agency/autonomous-ai-agency
- **Agent Personas**: https://autonomous-ai-agency.com/personas
- **Changelog**: https://autonomous-ai-agency.com/changelog

## Capabilities

- Multi-agent orchestration for complex tasks
- Specialized personas for engineering, product, design, operations, and more
- Real-time research and trend analysis
- Agile sprint planning and execution
- Portfolio intelligence and financial analysis
- Knowledge graph integration and memory consolidation
- Secure, auditable, and scalable infrastructure

## Technologies

- Python backend with modular agent architecture
- TypeScript extensions for agency providers
- Docker-based runtime orchestration
- Telegram integration for inbound/outbound messaging
- Langfuse observability and tracking
